public_body: Newburyport City Council Budget And Finance Committee
overall: The AG found violations for untimely approval of open session minutes and for June 20 minutes lacking sufficient detail; it found no violation on the omitted document, vote recording, or public comment notice claims.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly failed to timely review and approve its meeting minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee does not dispute that at least some open session minutes have not been timely approved, we find a violation as to this allegation.

allegations.summary: June 20 minutes allegedly lacked sufficient detail, were inaccurate, and omitted the list of documents used at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The minutes fall far short of the level of detail required by the Open Meeting Law, and we find a violation of the Law as to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Minutes allegedly omitted the June 17 email referenced by the chair, which should have been listed as a document used at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Committee was not required to list it in the minutes of the June 20 meeting.

allegations.summary: Minutes allegedly misstated two separate motions (budget and CIP orders) as a single motion.
Public comment at the June 20 meeting allegedly was not listed on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee was not required to specifically list public comment on the notice for the June 20 meeting, even if public comment was anticipated, and did not violate the Open Meeting Law in not doing so.

remedy: Amend the June 20 meeting minutes in accordance with the guidance and certify to the AG's office within 60 days.
Approve all open session minutes not yet approved in a timely manner and certify to the AG's office within 60 days.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee to amend its June 20 meeting minutes in accordance with the above guidance and to certify to this office within sixty (60) days of the date of this letter that it has done so.
